messages:
jamal: alert - SLO burn: gateway 5xx rate spiked ~12% in last 10m, multiple customer tickets about inference timeouts. seeing >5% of requests 502/504. anyone oncall? :rotating_light:

alert-bot: [SLO-BURN] service=hosted-gateway env=prod severity=page summary=5xx-rate > 5% (10m) link=https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd123/gateway-slos

maya: I'm on it. looking at logs now. quick question — are customers reporting consistent 502 or intermittent 504s?

jamal: mix, but several long-tail timeouts (504) from hosted inference paths. some 502s too. support says 7 distinct orgs hit errors in last 15m.

elaine: Loki quick query for last 20m: ```{app=\"gateway\"} |= \"HTTP/1.1\\\" 502\" | count_over_time({app=\"gateway\"}[10m])``` shows big bump from 22:35->22:46 UTC. breakdown by upstream: ```| json | unwrap upstream_service | count_over_time(... )``` — majority pointing at inference-router-v2 (ip: 10.23.5.*)

maya: traces look noisy. flamegraph shows long tail in inference-router outbound call to model-proxy (model-proxy -> kv-cache). example trace: https://traces.redwood.company/trace/9f8e7d (lots of spans stuck in wait-for-kv-cache)

jamal: could this be kv-cache saturation? we did see slightly elevated cache eviction earlier. any recent deploys?

sindre: pushed a small change 22:30 that tightened upstream circuit-breaker timeouts on inference-router from 20s -> 10s (commit 4f2b6c). rollout finished 22:33 to ~60% via canary. I reverted the rollout flag at 22:40 but the configmap still had a shorter timeout for some pods.

maya: that fits — shorter CB + transient cache slowness => gateway sees 502/504. repro steps I used:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}' -i``` response: 504 after ~10s with no body. logs show upstream reset (RST) and \"circuit-breaker: timeout\" entries.

elaine: dashboard panels: request latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.6s, error ratio from 0.9% -> 8.3% shortly after 22:35. link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd123/gateway-slos?from=now-30m

jamal: mitigation plan: 1) pin inference-router to previous config (rollback circuit-breaker to 20s) 2) scale model-proxy kv-cache pool by +2 replicas 3) add short-term routing policy to avoid canary nodes 4) notify support + customers with ETA. I'll take 1 and 3 now. maya please prepare a postmortem skeleton.

maya: taking 1 & 3. kubectl patch configmap inference-router-cb -n prod --patch '{"data":{"timeout":"20s"}}' then rollout restart deployment/inference-router. scaling model-proxy: `kubectl scale deploy/model-proxy --replicas=6 -n prod`.

sindre: I also disabled the canary feature-flag in the routing layer to avoid sending new traffic to the partial rollout pods. feature flag id ff/gateway-cb-2026. done at 22:46.

ops-bot: action log: rollback applied to inference-router (rollout id r-8873), model-proxy scaled +2, routing flag ff/gateway-cb-2026 disabled.

elaine: monitoring: 5xx rate down to 1.2% at 22:56, tail latencies improving. Loki shows diminished 502s from the previously offending IPs.

jamal: nice. keep watching 30m. create incident and tag support tickets: INC-20260314-72. maya add timeline + root cause hypothesis (cb too aggressive + kv-cache latency) and list follow-ups.

maya: will do. quick follow-ups: - add rate-limited retries with jitter for model-proxy calls - adjust CB to be adaptive instead of fixed 10s - add kv-cache latency SLO & alert - expand canary health checks to include outbound upstream latency

sindre: will open a PR for adaptive CB + tests. tagging @release-team for post-deploy validation steps.

alert-bot: [RESOLVED] service=hosted-gateway summary=5xx-rate back to baseline resolved_at=1923457845

jamal: closing thread for now. thanks everyone, please drop postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:
